quick_start.title: Quick Start

sweet_spot.title: Level Up Your Returns
sweet_spot.body: Styling, artistic furniture, lighting that pops in photos, and smart bathroom refreshes. This package helps you compete with the best in your area and snag those top-tier reviews.

asset_flip.title: Total Transformation
